Title: A Sales Agent reads its MCP connections
Expected result: HTTP 200 JSON `{ok: true, connections: [...]}`; each connection has id, name, url, status, tools

Title: Connection payload exposes has_token, never a token or secret value
Steps: 1. GET `/salesperson/mcp/connections` 2. scan the raw body for token / secret values
Expected result: no token, secret or password value in the body; token presence is a boolean `has_token`
